messages:
Ava (Eng Lead): Quick follow-up from the All-Hands — can we confirm the release cadence change? I thought we said major releases move to biweekly, but hotfixes stay weekly. How does that affect oncall handoffs and quality gates?
Sam (VP Eng): Yes, major -> biweekly, hotfixes still as-needed. Main impact: longer stabilization window before major cut. Oncall shouldn't grow but we'll shift some verification tasks to the release week.
Priya (Product): From roadmap POV: splitting major vs. minor helps predict timelines. Requesting a clear checklist so PMs know what qualifies as a "major".
Luca (SRE): We need explicit rollback and canary windows defined. Suggest: canary for 24h with automated health checks, then full rollout. Also update runbook for oncall to include release-day escalation matrix.
Maya (QA): Agree on checklist. Proposed quality bar for majors: all critical tests green, no >1 flaky test, regression eval within 3% of baseline for key prompts. Will put draft in QA Confluence.
Jamie (Eng Ops): Action items: 1) Ops handbook update (oncall tasks + deploy steps) 2) Automate canary health-check alerts 3) Add release-label taxonomy (major/minor/hotfix). I'll own 1 & 3.
Rohan (Platform): For Dedicated customers we need SLA alignment — rolling major deploys might affect maintenance windows. We should notify customers 72h in advance for majors and offer opt-out for a shorter maintenance window.
deploy-bot: "Deploy scheduled: canary rollout to 10% at 14:00 UTC, watch p95/p99 and error rate. If error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 > 400ms -> rollback"
Ava (Eng Lead): Thanks — can we sync Friday 11am to finalize checklist and doc owners? I can pull a short template. Also @Maya can you paste the regression eval script snippet you mentioned?
Maya (QA): Sure, snippet below (rough):
```
# run_regression.sh
python eval_regression.py --baseline baseline_v2.json --cand candidate_build --threshold 0.03 --prompts key_prompts.txt
```
I'll link the full harness in Confluence after review.
Sam (VP Eng): Good plan. One more: SLAs stay at 99.9% for hosted API; add a note in customer comms about expected short blips during major rollouts and our rollback policy. Ops, please craft a short RFC for customer-facing language.
Jamie (Eng Ops): Will draft RFC and ping legal for wording.
Ava (Eng Lead): Great — summary of owners: Jamie (ops handbook + labels + RFC), Maya (QA checklist + harness), Luca (runbook + canary checks), Rohan (customer notices for Dedicated). I'll schedule the Friday sync and drop calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Sam (VP Eng): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick follow-up.
Priya (Product): Adding acceptance criteria to the release ticket template today.
Ava (Eng Lead): Closing thread — will post meeting notes after Friday and link to the updated checklist.
